claim: A NEX header loading screen is a hazard for tools: the boot model read a header-screen NEX as banks from offset 512 and missed the tail until it skipped the screen as NEXLOAD does.

evidence.text: The boot model read a .nex with a header loading screen (byte 10 = 2) as banks from offset 512 and failed to find the tail; it now skips the screen as NEXLOAD does (nex_screen_size). This is the first build with one.
